arms.consensus: logistic of REACHED on the consensus percentile alone
arms.reached_head: the V2 REACHED/timing head (admission rule inside the fold)
arms.chip: reached_head plus the FG-vs-Pipeline spread when admitted in the fold
arms.spread_forced: reached_head plus the spread always (diagnostic, never served)

spread: |within-(side, year) percentile of Pipeline minus that of FanGraphs|, rows carrying both grades only (FanGraphs from list vintage 2017); may not be credited on R-LV (bug B9a)

serving.rule: serve the chip only if its Brier minus the consensus-only arm has a CI95 below zero on lv_dev (both sides pooled); otherwise serve the consensus-only arm

vm_oos_dev.verdict: development only; tilted; P(bust) Brier chip minus consensus-only CI95 below zero
vm_oos_dev.note: DS-17 P(bust) chip read (REACHED head plus the FG-vs-Pipeline spread when admitted): Brier 0.1816 against consensus-only 0.21601 (delta -0.03441, CI95 [-0.03954, -0.02948]); log loss 0.52987 against 0.62148 (delta -0.09161, CI95 [-0.10387, -0.07985]). The AUC is for reaching the majors, not the WAR label. TILTED toward any head that reads level: a debuted matrix row is read just before its debut, so its level at the read foretells the debut. Spent frame, not a claim.
